scenarios.title: Creatures with first strike deal combat damage in an earlier step than creatures without it

setup.notes: Combat damage steps are recorded separately: the first-strike combat damage step and the regular combat damage step.

decisions: A attacks player B with Youthful Knight (Elite Vanguard stays home unless a variant says otherwise).
B declares Grizzly Bears as the only blocker of Youthful Knight.
Both players pass priority with an empty stack in every step; no spells or abilities are used.
Combat damage is dealt: the first-strike combat damage step, then the regular combat damage step.

variants.label: bears_blocks
variants.expected: In the first-strike combat damage step Youthful Knight (2/1) deals 2 damage to Grizzly Bears (2/2), which dies in the state-based check before the regular step. Grizzly Bears deals no damage, and Youthful Knight survives undamaged. No damage is dealt to B.

variants.label: no_first_strike
variants.delta: A attacks with Elite Vanguard (2/1, no first strike) instead of Youthful Knight, and B still blocks with Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: No creature has first strike, so all combat damage is dealt simultaneously in the single regular step: Elite Vanguard and Grizzly Bears each deal 2 damage and both die.

variants.label: giant_blocks
variants.delta: B declares Hill Giant (3/3) as the blocker instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: In the first-strike step Youthful Knight deals 2 damage to Hill Giant, which survives with 2 damage marked. In the regular step Hill Giant deals 3 damage to Youthful Knight, which dies. Hill Giant stays on the battlefield with 2 damage.

variants.label: both_first_strike
variants.delta: B declares Benalish Knight (2/2, first strike) as the blocker instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Both creatures deal damage simultaneously in the first-strike step: Benalish Knight takes 2 and Youthful Knight takes 2, and both die. No creature deals damage in the regular step.

scenarios.title: A creature that gains first strike after the first-strike damage step still deals damage in the second step

setup.notes: Combat damage steps are recorded separately: the first-strike combat damage step and the regular combat damage step.

decisions: A attacks player B with Youthful Knight.
B declares Hill Giant as the blocker of Youthful Knight.
Both players pass priority through the declare blockers step; the first-strike combat damage step begins and Youthful Knight deals 2 damage to Hill Giant.
After that damage B casts Ambush, tapping four Mountains; both players pass and Ambush resolves, so blocking creatures gain first strike.
Both players pass priority; the second combat damage step begins.

variants.label: gained_after_first_step
variants.expected: Youthful Knight deals 2 damage to Hill Giant in the first-strike step. Hill Giant gains first strike afterwards and still deals its 3 combat damage in the second step, so Youthful Knight dies. Hill Giant survives with 2 damage marked.

variants.label: gained_before_first_step
variants.delta: B casts Ambush in the declare blockers step, before any combat damage is dealt, instead of after the first-strike damage.
variants.expected: Hill Giant has first strike when the first-strike step begins, so Hill Giant and Youthful Knight deal damage simultaneously in that step. Youthful Knight dies and Hill Giant has 2 damage marked. No creature deals damage in the second step.

scenarios.forge_notes: Ambush's PumpAll affects creatures that are blocking at resolution, so Hill Giant must still be a blocker when it resolves.

scenarios.title: A creature that loses first strike after dealing first-strike damage does not deal damage again in the second step

setup.notes: Combat damage steps are recorded separately: the first-strike combat damage step and the regular combat damage step.

decisions: A attacks player B with Youthful Knight.
B declares Hill Giant as the blocker of Youthful Knight.
Both players pass priority through the declare blockers step; the first-strike combat damage step begins and Youthful Knight deals 2 damage to Hill Giant.
After that damage B activates Walking Sponge, tapping it, targeting Youthful Knight and choosing that it loses first strike; both players pass and the ability resolves.
Both players pass priority; the second combat damage step begins.

variants.label: first_strike_removed
variants.expected: Youthful Knight loses first strike after already dealing damage and deals no damage in the second step. Hill Giant has 2 damage marked and survives. Hill Giant deals 3 damage to Youthful Knight in the second step and Youthful Knight dies.

variants.label: double_strike_in_response
variants.delta: In response to Walking Sponge's ability A casts Boros Charm (tapping Mountain and Plains) choosing the mode that gives Youthful Knight double strike, then the ability resolves too.
variants.expected: Boros Charm resolves first, then Walking Sponge removes first strike only; Youthful Knight keeps double strike and deals 2 more damage in the second step. Hill Giant (3/3) has taken 4 damage in total and dies, while its own 3 damage kills Youthful Knight.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge may re-select the second-step damage dealers from the creatures that currently lack first strike, which would let Youthful Knight strike twice in the first_strike_removed variant.
